title: Listening Drill — Indoor climbing induction — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Indoor climbing induction — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on indoor climbing induction last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with loose strap. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: worn buckle.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of harness fit so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow chalk bag instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the instructor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
